data: Microsoft's operating income for fiscal 2024 (year ended June 30, 2024) was $109,433 million, about $109.4 billion, compared with Amazon's $68,593 million, about $68.6 billion, for fiscal 2024 (year ended December 31, 2024). Microsoft's figure is roughly 1.6 times Amazon's (109,433 ÷ 68,593 ≈ 1.60), a gap of about $40.8 billion. Note that the two fiscal years end at different times, so the periods are not perfectly aligned. Microsoft's operating margin was about 44.6% on $245.1 billion of revenue, while Amazon's was about 10.8% on $638.0 billion of net sales.
